svg.title: Nuonuo v0.4 Decoupled System Architecture
svg.desc: Nuonuo v0.4 decoupled architecture: Thin clients and IM channels connect over unified /v1/* with 6-scope RBAC and rotating tokens, while external sources pass 2-stage filtering into the shell-free Router, Split-Phase Voice, and Sideband Memory; parallel Workers run through code-enforced Policy & Reviewer gates into Local/Docker, Playwright/MCP, macOS Apps, or Cloud Linux Desktop.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Subscription Bypass · Follow-ups route straight to the active Worker
